poc_details: Scope: deploy Redwood Private control plane components in Origen staging VPC via Terraform modules (provided by Redwood). Use Helm to install runtime agents and observability collectors. Integration notes: - Secrets must be stored in customer KMS (alias/aws/redwood-poc) and mounted via CSI driver. - Audit logs forwarded to customer Splunk HTTP Event Collector via TLS, retention configured to 7 years for clinical records. - Networking: private endpoints only, no internet egress for inference nodes; NAT only for OS patching scheduled windows. - Test plan: 1) infra validate (terraform plan/apply), 2) helm install + smoke (healthz, kv cache verify), 3) functional tests (chat latency p95 < 200ms, embeddings throughput 200 rps), 4) security tests (KMS key rotation, access revocation), 5) compliance artifacts delivered (SOC mapping, logs samples). - Sign-off: CISO + Infra Eng + Product (Priya) approval after 2-week soak and report.
